main_text.l: Abul Feda, &c. Primus (inquit) Regum Syriæ fuit
الحارث AlHareth, f. Amri, f. Ameri, f. Haretha, f.
Amrilkais, f. Mazeni, f. AlAzdi, &c. qui & ابن
ابي شمر Ebn Abi Shamer appellatus. Successerunt
ipsi in imperio {*} سبع وثلاثون 37. Reges, spatium autem
quo regnarunt erat annorum 616, usque ad ulti-
mum ipsorum جبلة Iabalah, qui imperante
Omaro Christianismum amplexus est. Quod si ita se habeat,
ac B. Paulus anno Christi 34. (ut Sethus Calvis.) per
Damasci munimenta in sporta demissus fit, Omar
autem anno 634. imperare coeperit. erit Aretas
iste cuius mentio 2 Cor. 11. 32. è prioribus familiæ
Gassaniæ regibus, forsan primus iste Harethus.
{*} سبعون وثلاثون
ملوك جرهم Reges Iorhamida.
Regnante Yaarebo in Yaman, regnavit in Hejaz.
1 جرهم Iorham, ipsius frater.
2 عبد ياليك Abd Talik, Iorhami filius.
3 جرشم Iorsham, Abd Talili filius.
4 عبد المدان Abdol Madan, Iorshami filius.
5 نقيلة Nogailah (vel forf. نقيلة Nakilah, vel
نفيلة Nophailah. AbdolMadani filius
6 عبد المسيح Abdolmasihi, Nogaila filius.
7 مضاض Modad, Abdol Masihi f.
8 عمرو Amrus, Modadi f.
9 الحارث AlHaretb, ipsius frater.
10 عمرو Amrus, AlHarethi filius.
11 بشر Bashar, ejus frater.
12 مضاض Modad f. Amri, f. (Modadi.

page.notes: Marginal note in the left margin reads "* Male in exempl. quo usus sum legitur," followed by Arabic "سبعون وثلاثون", which is the corrected reading of the Arabic numeral in the text (marked here as a footnote with {*}). The Arabic in the margin and in the text is small and partly uncertain; the Arabic personal names are transcribed as they appear but may contain small errors. The Latin in list line 5 is cut by the scan edge and is set in the original with an unclosed parenthesis. Line 12 ends with an unclosed parenthesis, as printed.
